Wednesday Evening Meet the Members Laps

London, United Kingdom · Richmond Park · Road · Social

Wednesday Evening Meet the Members Laps is a road and social group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm local time from Richmond Park (exact meeting point shown to Meetup members). Pace: chatty pace, split into groups by level.

For visitors

The website says 6:20 pm, Meetup says 6:00 pm: be there for 6:00. It is dark by the end in October, so bring lights. The club's website may stop the evening laps over winter; check Meetup.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: chatty pace, split into groups by level. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Wednesday Evening Meet the Members Laps group ride

A short, informal evening ride for people who want to meet the leaders and members before picking a level. Groups do a couple of laps of the park at a pace everyone can chat at, stopping after each lap, then head to a café or pub in Richmond or Kingston.
